label: Necessary concrete candidate with possible concurrent giving of being
term: necessary concrete source with possible exercise
definition: NecessaryConcreteWithPossibleConcurrentGivingAt f Concrete w holds iff some rigid concrete individual c exists at w and every world accessible from w, and some v accessible from w has ConcurrentTotalityGivingAt f Concrete v c: at least one actual exercise of the shared GivesAt primitive and giving to every contingent concrete member at every moment of its presence. This is a distinct stronger conclusion from a bare NecessaryConcreteAt at w, but does not transfer causal activity to w or identify the cause as unique, sufficient, or divine.
note: SAME c across worlds; the population/effects at v may differ from those at w. The possible-world source's actual exercise is preserved rather than discarded during the inference. Its externality in the witness history is an OPEN B2 commitment, not inferred from causing.
